column2: ADDITIONAL VIDEO FORMATS AVAILABLE IN PEG
column3: PEG 中可用的其它视频格式

column2: PeG's internal file filter for movies was originally hard coded into PEOPLES.EXE as "CINE\*.MOV" so only MOV files could be played.  Despite this, Quicktime can play a wide range of viodeos inlcuding AVI, (animated) GIF, MPG & SWF.
column3: PeG 内部用于影片的文件筛选器最初在 PEOPLES.EXE 中硬编码为 "CINE\*.MOV"，因此只能播放 MOV 文件。  尽管如此，Quicktime 仍能播放多种视频，包括 AVI、（动画）GIF、MPG 和 SWF。

column2: I changed the file filter to "CINE\*.*" so all these file types can now be played.  ANY video, still image or audio format which is playable in your version of Quicktime can be shown in PeG's campaign.
column3: 我把文件筛选器改为 "CINE\*.*"，因此现在这些文件类型都能播放。  凡是你的 Quicktime 版本能播放的视频、静态图像或声音格式，都能在 PeG 的战役中显示。

column2: Most videos look great. MPEG is acceptable but has some flakiness on my system which may be caused by my video codecs.
column3: 大多数视频看起来很好。MPEG 可以接受，但在我的系统上有些不稳定，可能是我的视频编解码器造成的。

column2: Quicktime displays still images such as JPEG but when displayed by Quicktime in PeG they flash by too quickly to be interesting or useful.  The best way to display single images is to use my "Information Graphics Approach" described below.
column3: Quicktime 能显示 JPEG 之类的静态图像，但在 PeG 中由 Quicktime 显示时，它们一闪而过，既不有趣也没用处。  显示单张图像的最好办法是采用下面介绍的“信息图形法”。

column3: 必须在 CAM 文件中指定完整文件名，包括实际的扩展名(.MOV、.AVI、.GIF、.SWF 等)。

column2: NEW VIDEO DEVELOPMENT
column3: 新视频开发

column2: What could be done with this new feature?
column3: 用这个新功能能做些什么？

column2: Existing or new AVIs, MPEGS, MOV or SWF could be used to enhance game ambience.
column3: 现有的或新的 AVI、MPEG、MOV 或 SWF 都可以用来增强游戏氛围。

column2: Animated GIF files could be used as more extensive & informative scenario introductions which combine text (larger & more legible!), maps & other graphics. These are easy to prepare using Paint Shop Pro and Animation Shop or other GIF animation software.
column3: 动画 GIF 文件可以用作内容更丰富、信息量更大的场景介绍，把文字（更大、更易读！）、地图和其它图形结合在一起。 使用 Paint Shop Pro 和 Animation Shop 或其它 GIF 动画软件很容易制作。

column2: THE NEWSREEL APPROACH TO VIDEOS
column3: 视频的新闻短片法

column2: Video files in PeG, PG2 and the Five Star General Games often try to provide "ambience" for game play.  The videos are mostly film clips showing tanks breezing along, infantry parading through town et cetera.
column3: PeG、PG2 和 Five Star General Games 中的视频文件常常试图为游戏过程营造“氛围”。  这些视频大多是影片片段，展示坦克轻快驶过、步兵列队穿过城镇等等。

column2: This is the NEWSREEL approach to video in PeG -- film footage displayed for the folks back home.
column3: 这就是 PeG 中视频的新闻短片法 -- 为后方家乡的人们播放的胶片素材。

column2: The files created for this purpose are often extremely large -- a minimum of 1 or 2 meg in most cases.  Generally, they also require a lot of memory, a fast CPU & a fast hard drive.
column3: 为此类用途制作的文件往往极大 -- 多数情况下至少有 1 到 2 兆。  一般来说，它们还需要大量内存、快速的 CPU 和快速的硬盘。

column2: These videos can be cool & informative.  PeG gamers with high speed Internet access may choose to download them.  However, PeG gamers who use dial up services to get files may decide to ignore these files.
column3: 这些视频可能很酷、信息量也大。  能高速上网的 PeG 玩家也许会下载它们。  然而，使用拨号服务获取文件的 PeG 玩家可能会决定不去理会这些文件。

column2: THE INFORMATION GRAPHICS APPROACH TO VIDEOS
column3: 视频的信息图形法

column2: I propose that a better use of video in PeG is to give strategic context to the game.  The Information Graphics approach can give the Theater Commander's perspective to PeG
column3: 我认为，在 PeG 中更好地利用视频的方式是为游戏提供战略背景。  信息图形法可以把战区司令官的视角带入 PeG

column2: Information Graphics is a modern term but the approach is at least as old as human writing and speech:  make a picture of the ideas & information you want to communicate.  USA today has demonstrated the WORST use of Information Graphics by attaching cute pictures to statistics
column3: “信息图形”是个现代术语，但这种做法至少和人类的文字与语言一样古老：把你想传达的想法和信息画成一幅图。  USA today 展示了信息图形最糟糕的用法：给统计数据配上可爱的图片

column2: The questions which need to be addressed:
column3: 需要回答的问题：

column2: \tWhy is this battle or series of battles important?
column3: \t为什么这场战斗或这一系列战斗重要？

column2: \tWhat else is going on?
column3: \t还发生了什么？

column2: \tHow does this campaign relate to those other events?
column3: \t这场战役与其它那些事件有什么关联？

column2: What is the Theater context of
column3: 什么是……的战区背景

column2: \t* Space
column3: \t* 空间

column2: \t* Time
column3: \t* 时间

column2: \t* Resources
column3: \t* 资源

column2: The answer:
column3: 答案：

column2: \tUse a regional map, other graphics and brief text to place the battle in context.
column3: \t用区域地图、其它图形和简短文字把这场战斗放进背景中。

column2: \tDisplay all of this as in a slide show with 1-10 images.
column3: \t把这一切以幻灯片放映的形式展示，使用 1-10 张图像。

column2: \tUse  30-90 second time delay overall.
column3: \t整体使用 30-90 秒的延时。

column2: DIVISION AZUL.GIF is an animated GIF file which demonstrates the concept of using PeG videos for information graphics rather than movies.  The emphasis is on showing information that puts each scenario into a larger context of space, time & resources.
column3: DIVISION AZUL.GIF 是一个动画 GIF 文件，用来演示把 PeG 视频用于信息图形而非影片的思路。  重点在于展示信息，把每个场景放进更大的空间、时间与资源背景中。

column2: This demonstration is not exhaustive of  the approach and is not intended for actual use with the Division Azul Campaign by Santiago Fuertes (PG2 original) & Robert Mary (PeG version).
column3: 这个演示并未穷尽这一方法，也无意用于 Santiago Fuertes(PG2 原版)与 Robert Mary(PeG 版)的 Division Azul 战役。

column2: KEY FEATURES:
column3: 主要特点：

column2: * SMALL DOWNLOAD\tThe file is less than 150k so it will be a short download even using dial-up modem access.
column3: * 下载量小\t文件不到 150k，所以即使用拨号调制解调器访问，下载也很快。

column2: * EASILY MODIFIED\tAll elements of the design -- including text, color scheme, maps, photos & other graphics -- can easily be modified.
column3: * 易于修改\t设计的所有元素 -- 包括文字、配色方案、地图、照片和其它图形 -- 都可以轻松修改。

column2: * SIMPLE DEVELOPMENT\tCreating this demo took about an hour including gathering maps, the division insignia, preparing some other graphics, experimenting & testing.  .
column3: * 制作简单\t制作这个演示大约花了一小时，包括收集地图、师徽、准备其它一些图形以及试验和测试。

column2: * FLEXIBLE FORMAT\tAn animation can consist of just 1 slide or many slides as the designers chooses.   This demo consists of three slides each of which is 800x600 pixels.
column3: * 格式灵活\t动画可以只有 1 张幻灯片，也可以按设计者的选择包含许多张。  这个演示由三张幻灯片组成，每张都是 800x600 像素。

column2: The slides display for 5-15 seconds.  Display time can be made longer or shorter when a file is created.  Users can terminate the display by clicking the mouse or pressing a key.
column3: 幻灯片显示 5-15 秒。  显示时间可以在创建文件时调长或调短。  用户可以通过点击鼠标或按键结束显示。

column2: PRODUCTION METHODS:
column3: 制作方法：

column2: Slides were initially prepared using MS-Paint.
column3: 幻灯片最初是用 MS-Paint 制作的。

column2: Text was written and edited in Windows Notepad and then pasted into a text entry block.
column3: 文字在 Windows Notepad 中撰写和编辑，然后粘贴到文本输入框中。

column2: Maps were copied from Microsoft Encarta World Atlas and pasted into MS-Paint.  Using Paint I cropped the maps and added circles & arrows.
column3: 地图从 Microsoft Encarta World Atlas 复制并粘贴到 MS-Paint 中。  我用 Paint 裁剪地图并加上圆圈和箭头。

column2: The sample Order of Battle graphic was also prepared in MS Paint.
column3: 示例战斗序列图形也是在 MS Paint 中制作的。

column2: Each slide was loaded into Animation Shop where the time delay was set separately.  The result was saved in the Animated GIF video format.
column3: 每张幻灯片都载入 Animation Shop，在那里分别设置延时。  结果以动画 GIF 视频格式保存。
